title: Mindfulness Seminar 3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating mindfulness in everyday life by being fully present with whatever task or situation you're in at that moment. This involves not just sitting in stillness, but also applying awareness and attention to all aspects of your daily experiences, from simple tasks like driving or listening to a child to more complex activities. By doing so, you can develop a sense of respect for your life and its various aspects, and maintain a clear and present awareness even as you move between different postures or activities.
